title: Service or utility room for energy storage systems: which discipline reviews and inspects it
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 (National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: October 2026 (platform created October 15, 2026, last updated October 15, 2026)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies that a building safety codes officer reviews and inspects the design and construction of a room containing energy storage systems where the room provisions are in the 2024 Canadian Electrical Code, Part 1.
Electrical and building SCOs had raised concerns about which discipline administers the CE Code Part 1 Rule 64-1100 requirements for the room.
Under the Permit Regulation, if construction in the building discipline is undertaken, a building permit is required.
Alternative locations for wall, ceiling and floor assemblies may be considered, subject to acceptance by the local authority having jurisdiction.
